name: Gladly
one_liner: Customer service and commerce AI platform (gladly.com, now gladly.ai) with REST API, Lookup API, webhooks and App Platform.
auth_notes: Token-based HTTP Basic: username is agent email, password is API token. User needs API User permission granted by an admin. Tokens have unrestricted API access.
access_notes: No public signup, pricing page or trial found (gladly.com/pricing redirects to marketing site gladly.ai). Credentials come from a customer org's admin (Settings > Users > API User). Sandbox enabled separately at {org}.gladly.qa.

buildability.rationale: Well-documented OpenAPI with webhooks and 10 req/s limits, but no self-serve account: needs an existing Gladly customer org, admin-granted API User permission, and sandbox enablement via Gladly.

needs_human_reason: No public signup, trial or pricing found; confirm how a developer obtains a Gladly org or sandbox (sales contact likely).

evidence.quote: To create and use an API token, your user must have the API User permission.
Your sandbox environment is accessible at `https://{organization}.gladly.qa`

disputes.why: OpenAPI root lists about 64 path entries.
Agree unknown: no self-serve signup or pricing evidence; third-party sources say no free trial, unverified.
